== English errata comparison sources ==
The Players Committee removed the destination qualifier in the first option. The relocation, Force cost and Reserve Deck option remain. The earlier Wiki replacement article listed <code>5_47</code>. At pinned Guild GEMP revision <code>473041b13f5573c8cd76eacbc28d6b741e8da887</code>, that class retains the deleted clause, and the current bare Wiki lookup points to the original. Preserve the original’s historical <code>5_47o</code> label and document the PC publication without a playable mapping.
